name: Typhon Will

abilities.name: Gale Leap
abilities.effect: A huge sprinting leap on borrowed storm speed, red-gold streaks and sparks behind.

abilities.name: Storm Eye
abilities.effect: The cheek mark flares and the holder sees through rain and smoke, outlining up to six creatures.

acquire.equipPiece: A single storm-iron arm-guard with a lightning fork cut into it, on the right forearm (the only equipped piece).

abilities.name: Storm-Fire Breath
abilities.effect: Fire and lightning breathed from the dragon heads in a short storm cone that burns and stuns.

abilities.name: Typhoon Vortex
abilities.effect: A storm vortex of wind, fire and sparks rises around the giant, pulls foes in and hurls them out.

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form: the whole body becomes a storm-giant beastman in black storm-iron armor: a central dragon head with fiery eyes plus four small dragon heads on the pauldrons, storm-cloud wings, two viper tails from the hips, clawed arms, digitigrade clawed legs and a fiery spine ridge; a forked lightning-and-flame polearm forms in the hand.

equip.weapon: A forked polearm of lightning and flame formed in the right hand.
equip.armor: Black storm-iron plates with ember seams, five dragon-head pauldrons (one big, four small), a storm-cloud wing mantle and clawed greaves.
equip.hair_eyes: Flame-red hair streaming upward, burning gold eyes.
equip.aura: Crackling lightning and smoke with a fiery spine ridge.

lore: Typhon, Father of Monsters: a hundred dragon heads that roar with every voice, fire in the eyes and vipers at the thighs.
pitch: Typhon is the Father of Monsters of Greek myth, a hundred-headed storm-and-fire giant with vipers at its thighs. Acquire keeps you human, leaping in red-gold streaks with one storm-iron arm-guard. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a five-headed storm-giant in black iron armor with a lightning polearm, the strongest kit of all wills, paid for with the second-highest drain and the heaviest strain.
untrained: An untrained holder is blasted by their own thunder voice: ringing ears, scorching fever and uncontrolled flashes of lightning that hit the holder first. Canon: a will that is not suppressed or balanced disrupts body and mana core and can eventually kill the holder, so the first Awakening (forced, a spark in the core) is the most dangerous moment and training both cores is the cure.

spirit.echo: A towering storm-giant beastman in black storm-iron armor: one big dragon head with burning eyes and four small dragon heads on the pauldrons, storm-cloud wings, two viper tails, clawed arms, digitigrade legs, fiery spine and a forked polearm.
spirit.look: A storm-orb of swirling black cloud with a molten red-fire core and tiny gold lightning forks.
